faq.q: Are there any active Dig & Clean codes right now?
faq.a: No verified active codes as of August 8, 2026. The game is still in its early release period and has not added a public code redemption menu.

faq.q: When will Dig & Clean codes be released?
faq.a: Roblox simulation games usually add codes after the first major update or when the game hits a visits/likes milestone. We monitor the official channels regularly and update this page as soon as codes appear.

faq.q: How do I redeem a code in Dig & Clean?
faq.a: Open the game, find the Codes button or Settings menu, paste the code exactly, and press Confirm. If there is no Codes button, the feature has not been enabled yet.

faq.q: Do codes give free shovels or coins?
faq.a: When Dig & Clean adds codes, rewards will likely be coins or small boosts. We will list the exact reward for every confirmed code.

faq.q: Can I use codes from DIG or Dig It in Dig & Clean?
faq.a: No. DIG and Dig It are different games. Only codes published specifically for Dig & Clean by Squeaky Clean! will work.
